scenario.title: The leaning local
scenario.description: One leg is short. Slow rolls bend downhill.

curriculum.lesson: The downhill arrow shows how the uneven surface bends moving balls. A gentle, long approach has more time to drift than a brisk, short one. Compare both balls and all three strokes, including the final slow part of each cue-ball route. In the result, zoom into the highlighted slow tail and compare its bend with its initial direction.
curriculum.takeaway: On an uneven surface, time spent rolling matters as much as distance.

briefing.gotcha: The aim is compensated for this table, but small speed changes also change how much the ball curves.

conditions.name: Uneven surface
conditions.description: Moving balls drift in the arrow direction. Slower journeys bend further; resting balls stay put.
